title: Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?
caption: Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V)
lore: Greedo cheskopokuta klees ruya Solo. Hoko yanee boopa gush Cantina. Cheeco wa Solo's anye nyuma Greedo vakee. Jabba kul steeka et an anpaw.
game_text:
USED: During battle at a site where your alien bounty hunter (except Boba Fett) is with opponent’s smuggler, opponent may not draw more than one battle destiny.
LOST: During a battle at a site where you have an alien bounty hunter, add one battle destiny.
